description: Check the official legal notices (BODACC) of a French company by SIREN: tells whether it is under insolvency proceedings (safeguard, receivership, liquidation) or struck off, and lists its latest notices with dates, court and links. Useful for supplier/customer due diligence and KYB. Official DILA open data. Price: $0.005 per call, paid in USDC on Base via x402. You are not charged when the call fails or finds nothing.

limit.description: Number of latest notices listed, 1 to 20 (default 10)

siren.description: 9-digit SIREN of a French company, e.g. 552081317

name: check_bodacc_notices
title: French company legal notices (BODACC)
